_comment: Committed defaults. Put machine-specific overrides (serial ports, calibration) in config/local.json (git-ignored).

search_bounds._comment: Explicit Edinburgh box for the acoustic search. Deliberately NOT centred on the venue.

aircraft_collection._comment: Wider than the search box: audible aircraft may be outside Edinburgh. radius in nautical miles.

configured_location._comment: CONFIGURED presentation context only. Never displayed as a measured acoustic result.
configured_location.label: The Nucleus, King's Buildings (approximate, configured)

acoustics._ground_comment: Approximate flat ground height above MSL for Edinburgh search (no terrain model). Disclose in results.

pressure._comment: Source is the phone barometer app streamed over HTTP (phyphox remote access) or a CSV export. Set phone_url in config/local.json, e.g. http://192.168.137.12 .

survey._comment: Measured in the Nucleus on 7 Nov 2026 with the phone barometer. Absolute values drift with weather: only the deltas are reused. Re-zero at the reference floor before the demo.
